desc: 蜜糖红木开框扶手加浅灰布艺坐垫，墨灰墙暖光禅意客厅成套
leaf: 新中式蜜糖红木框架浅灰布艺转角沙发组合
name: 新中式实木框架灰布艺沙发组合款

shots.intent: 首屏用墨灰背景墙加暖光斜射的禅意客厅一秒立住「新中式成套客厅」的风格认领，让目标人群停下滑动。
shots.textZone: 右上墨灰留白：竖排主标题「{selling_point_1}」白色衬线大字，其左一枚朱砂 #9E2B25 圆形印章「{callout_1}」，再左一列竖排细字「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 干净的宣纸白底单品图，把裸露木框架的开口扶手、贵妃位朝向与底座脚座一次看清，负责搜索流量的一眼点击。
同机位俯视分屏放大「中式客厅一上深色红木就显闷显老气」的真实顾虑，用布面坐垫加裸露木框的轻感把痛点对冲掉。
shots.textZone: 顶部通栏 #4A4A50 色带一行衬线主标「{selling_point_2}」带一枚朱砂圆点装饰，两格底角各一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 贴地斜仰的实景把这套沙发放回可坐可躺可喝茶的生活现场，用茶车与地毯给出人体尺度，让买家代入自家客厅。
shots.textZone: 左下角一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，不加其它文字

shots.intent: 正侧面近摄把这套沙发最强的识别点——裸露木框的开口扶手、顶 rail 与横档接角和漆面反光——做实，回答「值不值这个价」。
shots.textZone: 上方留白带：衬线小标题「{selling_point_3}」与其下一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，1px 朱砂引线指向接角

shots.intent: 俯角微距把浅灰布面的织纹走向与坐垫边线、和木座框的接触关系看清，把材质与坐感疑虑落到可见证据上。
shots.textZone: 右侧留白带：小标题「{selling_point_4}」与其下两枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，1px 引线指向边线

shots.intent: 镜头贴地的仰视把木质底座、脚座缺口与落地接触做实，证明承重观感与整机比例不是贴图。
shots.textZone: 底部一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，以 1px 朱砂引线连到脚座

shots.intent: 同墙同光同框对比靠墙一字摆法与贵妃位围合摆法，让买家按自家开间自己判断摆法，一次解决占地焦虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_5}」，两格底角各一枚小标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 一屏排开实际可选的木色处理与位数组合，让买家先把选型这一犹豫解决掉，替代源页款式图的杂牌混排。
shots.textZone: 每个变体底缘一枚短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，同一条对齐基线，其上一行朱砂小标「{selling_point_6}」

shots.intent: 用三枚看点圆盘加一张通用参数表把「看什么、含什么」摊开，用透明结构而不是空洞承诺降风险。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_7}」；三枚圆盘各配一枚衬线短标「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」；下方四行通用参数表行名为产品名称／产品规格／材质／包装方式，数值一律为占位符「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 复用首屏机位的暖灯夜景收口，把整页情绪落回可住可享的中式客厅，再给一个明确的咨询量尺动作。
shots.textZone: 下方三分之一宣纸留白：主标「{selling_point_1}」，其下一枚直角方形按钮，填色 #9E2B25，内一行行动文案「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a real new-Chinese living room with an ink-charcoal feature wall #4A4A50 over a polished dark stone floor #2E2C2B carrying a soft mirror sheen, one warm lace-trimmed sheer curtain at a declared frame edge and either two small brass-framed #B4924F prints or a vertical scroll set hung above the seating; a seamless rice-paper ivory studio field #F5F2EC or pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, anatomy diagrams and spec screens; and one flat ink-grey graphic band #4A4A50 or solid vermilion block #9E2B25 for process and trust layouts. Photographs are enclosed by hairline vermilion #9E2B25 corner-bracket frames with classic Chinese corner ornaments, never rounded cards; one clean copy zone per screen and never busy decor
style.direction: new-Chinese zen living-room commerce, warm ink-and-rice-paper editorial with a vermilion seal accent rather than airy nordic daylight or a neutral mid-tone graphic interior
style.iconSystem: solid ink-grey discs #6E6E6E with one serif word label centred beneath them for the three-point feature row, plus vermilion #9E2B25 arrow-flag tags carrying a three-character white label, plus hairline vermilion corner-bracket frames around photographs; no western monoline pictograms, no 3D badges, no gradient seals, no rounded pill labels, no square number chips
style.lightingSystem: warm interior grade: a 3000-3200K key entering from a declared off-frame window side through a sheer lace curtain, so defined but believable shadow rakes fall on the ink wall behind the seating, plus a soft amber bounce fill on the shadow side and a low 2700K practical where a lamp is in frame; satin specular highlights only along the lacquered wood edges, deep warm falloff into the corner, one grounded contact shadow under the plinth base and a soft floor reflection; this is deliberately NOT a cool 6500K north-daylight wash and NOT a flat neutral 4200K downlight wash
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent new-Chinese zen living-room visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of rice-paper ivory #F5F2EC, ink-charcoal wall #4A4A50, vermilion seal red #9E2B25 and ink text #2B2A28, with product tones taken unchanged from the reference honey-red wood #A65A2E and pale heather-grey upholstery #C9C8C4; warm interior grade; one high-contrast Ming-style serif family for Chinese display headlines, each headline carrying one small vermilion circle brush flourish over its first glyph, a light sans only for numerals and small labels, all Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 and kept short; backgrounds limited to a real new-Chinese living room with an ink-charcoal feature wall #4A4A50 over a polished dark stone floor #2E2C2B with a soft sheen, one warm lace-trimmed sheer curtain at a declared frame edge and either two small brass-framed #B4924F prints or a vertical scroll set above the seating, a seamless rice-paper ivory studio field #F5F2EC or pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, and one flat ink-grey band #4A4A50 or solid vermilion block #9E2B25 for process and trust layouts, photographs closed by hairline vermilion corner-bracket frames with classic Chinese corner ornaments, one clean copy zone per screen; lighting always warm 3000-3200K key from a declared off-frame window side through a sheer lace curtain casting defined but believable shadow rakes on the ink wall, soft amber bounce fill, optional 2700K practical, satin speculars only on lacquered wood edges, deep warm falloff, one grounded contact shadow plus a soft floor reflection, never a cool 6500K daylight wash and never a flat neutral downlight wash; surface system of exposed honey-red solid wood with visible grain exactly as supplied, matte pale heather-grey woven upholstery with no gloss, dark polished stone floor, ivory low-pile rug #DCD7CC, oxblood silk #7E2429 and striped fur accents and cognac amber glass #A85C1E; icon system of solid ink-grey discs #6E6E6E with a serif label beneath, vermilion arrow-flag tags with three-character white labels and hairline corner brackets, no monoline pictograms, no number chips, no 3D badges; product presentation rules: identical scale, identical loose cushion and back-cushion count, identical open rectangular wooden arm with one cross rail, identical plinth base with carved foot cut-outs, identical chaise side, identical wood tone and weave in every frame, seated on the floor with a contact shadow and a soft reflection, corrected straight verticals, a real furnishing as scale anchor, the slight 3/4 warm-key angle reused across scene screens; no color palette changes, no recoloured upholstery, no restyled arm, no added or removed module, no mixed fonts, no rounded cards, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented timber species, wood grade, lacquer or joinery claims, fabric content, foam density, load rating, dimensions, eco grades or certificates, no brand marks, no QR codes, no membership badges, no prices, no people.
noDrift: no cool 6500K nordic daylight grade and no flat neutral 4200K downlight wash
no recoloured, re-woven or re-tufted upholstery, no vinyl or leather sheen on the cloth
no restyled arm: the open rectangular wooden arm with one cross rail stays exactly as supplied
no added or removed chaise module, no invented headrest, quilting, piping, buttons or carved aprons
no mixed fonts: never replace the Ming serif display face with a heavy bold geometric sans
no random backgrounds and no rounded cards
no inconsistent lighting direction, no missing wall shadow rakes and no contradictory shadow lengths
no western monoline pictograms, no number chips, no gradient seals
no invented timber species, wood grade, lacquer type, joinery claim, fabric or cotton content, foam density, load rating, dimension, eco grade or certificate
no brand mark, no QR code, no membership or free-gift corner badge, no price, no contact details
no people, no hands and no visible faces; any reused figure must be anonymous and cropped
style.presentationRules: the sofa keeps one proportional scale and the same identity in every frame: the same count of loose seat cushions and loose back cushions, the same open rectangular wooden arm built from a flat top rail and one lower cross rail, the same exposed wood stiles, the same low wooden plinth base with its carved foot cut-outs, the same chaise module and its side, the same honey-red wood tone and the same pale heather-grey weave; it stands on the floor with a real contact shadow and a soft reflection and never floats; interior verticals, wall corners, curtain lines and picture frames stay straight and corrected; a real furnishing (tea trolley, side table, rug, hung prints) always anchors human scale; the slight 3/4 warm-key angle of the opening screen is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one room
style.surfaceSystem: exposed solid wood rendered exactly as supplied at honey-red #A65A2E with visible grain and a satin lacquer edge, deep espresso #3A2318 in the frame shadows; loose upholstery stays matte pale heather-grey woven cloth #C9C8C4, never gloss, vinyl or leather; dark polished stone floor #2E2C2B with a soft reflection, ivory low-pile rug #DCD7CC, oxblood silk accent cushion #7E2429 with a small bird motif, black-and-ivory striped fur cushion #3A3735 over #E8E5DE, cognac amber glass #A85C1E on a dark timber #5A3220 tea table; matte rice-paper graphic fields for every layout screen
style.typography: one high-contrast Ming-style serif family for Chinese display headlines, thin-to-thick strokes, set in #2B2A28 on ivory fields and #F5F2EC on ink fields, always carrying one small vermilion #9E2B25 circle brush flourish overlapping the first headline glyph; a light sans is used only for numerals, table values and small labels; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short, headline 28-40pt, kicker 12-14pt, labels 10-13pt, per-screen text budget under 50 characters; never set the display line in a heavy bold geometric sans
